steps.title: Welcome to BaoBao!
steps.body: Hi there! I'm BaoBao, your panda companion. I'm here for the good days and the tough ones. Let me show you around.

steps.title: Tell me how you feel
steps.body: Tap me whenever you want to talk. Pick how you're feeling — happy, okay, sad, anxious, or tired — and I'll meet you there.

steps.title: We talk at your pace
steps.body: I'll share a thought and you choose how to reply. There are no wrong answers, and you can stop whenever you like.

steps.title: Little pick-me-ups
steps.body: Ask me for a joke, a kind word, or a self-care idea any time. They're always free.

steps.title: Play the claw machine
steps.body: Hold to move the claw, let go to drop it. Prizes turn into ✷ you can spend. You get five tries, and one comes back every five minutes.

steps.title: Make this space yours
steps.body: Spend ✷ in the shop on music, outfits, and backgrounds, then switch between them whenever you like.

steps.title: When things feel heavy
steps.body: If you've been feeling low for a while, I may gently suggest some extra support. You can also find helplines any time under Settings → Get help.

steps.title: Your feelings stay yours
steps.body: Everything you tell me stays on this device, locked away. You can delete it all whenever you want.
